Dirty Monitor est un studio de creation enthousiaste, pionnier dans le domaine de la conception

v.description: Sukhothai, Thailand Wikipedia: Sukhothai was the capital of the Sukhothai Kingdom. Sukhothai is 12 km west of the modern city of Sukhothai Thani. Founded in 1238, it is about 427 km north of Bangkok. Sukhothai was the capital of the Thai Empire for approximately 140 years. As of 2014, 193 temples have been excavated and partly reconstructed. The stele of Ram Khamhaeng states the city had a triple wall and four gates. At its center was a pond, a "marvelous pond of clear and delicious water like the water of the Mekong in the dry season."

v.description: Looking along Bissensgade street in the Aarhus K cultural quarter, Aarhus, Denmark. The sky is cloudless and bright cold blue. A dark street lamp hangs down mid-road from wires. Cars are parked at in an orderly fashion on either side of the street. Rows of windows on the high older buildings. At the end of the road, it meets Marstrandsgade. Framed: a striking light blue historic building on Marstrandsgade. Above it, a red and blue section of the circular Your Rainbow Panorama on top of the unseen Aros Art Museum (kunstmuseum) on the far side of Marstrandsgade. Photo March 2026 (c)Ciara Ní Riai

v.description: Centum City (센텀시티) is a urban development part of Busan, South Korea. The site was originally the location of Busan's Suyeong Airport. The Busan Cinema Center on the right was designed by Coop Himmelb(l)au and features the longest cantilever roof in the world.

Oh and yay for light pollution which makes the sky all lit up! lol

The historical marker Denkzeichen Georg Elser is a sculpture in Berlin-Mitte commemorating to the German opponent of Nazism and Hitler-assassin Georg Elser . The 17-meter high sculpture was created by the artist Ulrich Klages and was opened to the public on 8 November 2011. It is situated at the corner Wilhelmstraße /An der Kolonnade and is completed by two quotes from Elser, that were set into the sidewalk, and by an information board.

Lighted with LEDs, the Superstar is a shining symbol for green innovations.

Sound and light show at Karnak
v.description: The Sound and Light Show at Karnak was great especially with the full moon shining down. The show started at the entrance to the temple and continued on through the complex until reaching the sacred lake were we were seated. Various parts of the temple would be illuminated with light and a sound system would explain about this part of Egypt at the time of the Temple of Karnak. I went to 4 different Sound and Light Shows in Egypt, for me this was the best but the others were worth seeing also as they are all different.

v.description: Signal for a Green Future High above the ground, technicians attach over 9,000 LEDs to the rotor blades of the Fröttmaning wind power plant. Experts in project management and from the wind, lighting and energy businesses joined forces to make the Siemens Superstar shine in only two weeks. Art and business worked as partners to set a signal for a green future. Because time is running out: Ever-scarcer resources and climate change are threatening our planet. Drawing on the world‘s biggest environmental portfolio, Siemens AG is helping protect our climate.

Iceberg est composé d’une série d’arches métalliques lumineuses qui diffusent des sons particuliers. Organisées en tunnel, elles invitent les visiteurs à s’y engouffrer pour écouter et pour jouer de cet orgue géant dont les notes et la lumière voyagent d’un bout à l’autre de ce corridor musical. v.description: Luminothérapie, édition 2021-2022, Place des Festivals, Montréal. Impulsion fait vivre une expérience interactive de sons et de lumières. Elle présente une série de grandes bascules dont l’intensité lumineuse et les tonalités varient lorsque vous les mettez en mouvement. À partir de cet instrument urbain, participez à la création d’un environnement éphémère sans cesse renouvelé. Impulsion reprend des concepts du sérialisme, technique fondée sur la répétition d’éléments musicaux et leur variation, pour créer des zones d’intensité et de calme. Amusez-vous ! v.description: Zug der Linie C14 nach Mittweida auf der Bahnhofstraße zwischen der Haltestelle Hauptbahnhof, Bahnhofstraße und dem Bahnhof Chemnitz Hbf mit dem Übergang ins Fernbahnnetz. Noch verkehrt der Triebwagen elektrisch, beim Halt im Hauptbahnhof wird Dieselbetrieb umgeschaltet, obwohl dies Strecke nach Mittweida durchgehend elektrifiziert ist. Der VMS hat jedoch bisher nur Zweikrafttriebwagen beschafft.

v.description: Gleis 31 (Bahnsteig 4), das Übergangsgleis für Züge in Richtung Fernbahnnetz. Der Triebwagen fährt auf der Linie C14 nach Mittweida (Nachschuss), trotz der auf dieser Strecke vorhandenen Fahrleitung im Dieselbetrieb. Die Chemnitzbahn hat für die erste Betriebsstufe nur Zweikrafttriebwagen beschafft. Die Bahnsteige der Übergangsgleise sind aufgrund der Geländeverhältnisse auffallend geneigt.

With this project, Siemens AG has created a highly visible symbol for green technologies – for the entire lighting installation uses less energy than two electric kettles. And the Siemens Superstar draws its own electricity directly from the wind turbine – emission-free.

Attraction désormais emblématique du Quartier des spectacles, les vidéoprojections architecturales proposent pour la première fois une œuvre unique déclinée sur huit façades du Quartier. v.description: Light Up Bristol on College Green , projected onto the Council House. Bristol's very own Christmas son et lumière , Light Up Bristol, involved huge projections thrown up onto the Council House and the Cathedral. There was artificial snow, as well, but this was the last night, and they'd run out. All the pictures in this series were taken handheld at ISO 1600, mostly at f/1.4, with focus manually set to approximately infinity, because autofocus wasn't up to the job under the circumstances.

v.description: Dialog is a light installation on Strömparterren that was inspired by the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2009. Charles K. Kao then received the prize for “groundbreaking achievements concerning the transmission of light in fibers for optical communication”. The light installation was designed by Fredrik Jönsson. The concept consists of strong animated light rays directed towards the sky. Bright moving light fixtures will produce a cluster of strong light rays, similar to what happens on the inside of fiber optic cables.

v.description: The light artwork Oil Tank 468 in Kruunuvuorenranta (Laajasalo), Helsinki, Finland. The artwork is a fixed light and landscape artwork. Two thousand perforations have been made in the steel shell and the tank glows like a lantern. The oil tank will be left in the area, although the whole former harbour will be turned residential with fresh apartment blocks.

v.description: Luminothérapie, édition 2016-2017, Quartier des spectacles, Montréal Place des festivals Cet hiver, lors de la 7e édition de Luminothérapie, la place des Festivals se transforme en un vaste terrain de jeux interactif en accueillant une série de treize zootropes géants. LOOP, cette oeuvre interactive et participative, réchauffe assurément les publics de tous âges qui doivent activer avec entrain les cylindres pour voir défiler des images inspirées de contes pour enfants. Accompagnant ces dessins animés géants, se fait entendre les sons d’une boîte à musique placée au coeur de chacun des zootrop

v.description: Luminothérapie, édition 2020-2021, Quartier des spectacles, Montréal Quartier des spectacles Spectrum - une installation lumineuse, sonore et interactive : Les roues géantes et lumineuses d’Olivier Girouard, Jonathan Villeneuve et Ottoblix reviennent avec une nouvelle expérience en hommage à la littérature québécoise. La place des Festivals prend des allures rétrofuturistes avec Loop, œuvre interactive composée de 12 zootropes géants que vous devez activer pour voir s’animer et défiler des images d’illustrateurs québécois inspirées d’œuvres littéraires d’ici, dont, Joséphine Bacon, Dany Laferr

Projection mapping on Centre de design de l'UQAM
v.description: Centre de design de l'UQAM, Montréal Les huit façades de vidéoprojection du Quartier des spectacles évoquent, avec Fascinoscope, l’ambiance envoûtante d’une fête foraine du début du XXe siècle. Chacune est accompagnée d’une trame sonore originale composée d’orgue mécanique, de basse électronique et de batterie. Aux abords du métro Saint-Laurent, point central de l’œuvre, vous êtes convié à participer à quatre jeux interactifs inspirés des grands classiques de la fête foraine. Le dispositif est actionné par quatre ballons-poires munis de capteurs mesurant la rotation et la vitesse des ballons.

Experts for a Green Future Attaching 9,000 LEDs at great heights so they withstand high humidity, rain, storms and freezing temperatures is a major challenge. Siemens AG tackled this challenge in November 2009 and in only two weeks transformed the Fröttmaning wind power plant into the world‘s biggest Christmas star. Experts from the wind, lighting and energy businesses with exceptional technical know-how and project experience made the job possible in such a short time.

v.credit: Mexico-6261 - The Show Ends - I need SLEEP
v.description: All through the show I had a young girl sitting beside me with her mother. Every time I took a picture she wanted to see it and would then smile. A one point I let her take a couple of pictures, even thought they were blurred, she was very happy. It is this type of experience that makes travelling such a wonderful thing. Monuments and building are great but people everywhere are amazing and wonderful, even when we cannot talk the same language, a smile is universal. Well it was time to leave and get a good nights sleep, I had a long day from 4:30 am with so much walking and high temperatures.

A Photo of MIKONTALOLIGHTS event. The object of MIKONTALOLIGHTS project was to create the world's physically largest colored graphics platform by using the windows of Mikontalo's D-staircase as light pixels. The platform is used to play Tetris and other games and present demos created by the students of Tampere University of Technology. The project will climax on December the 4th when the new lights of Mikontalo will be lit. The goal is to gain global visibility for Tampere University of Technology and the rich student culture of Tampere.

v.description: Place des festivals, Montréal Nuage de givre est composé de 100 000 particules d’eau, regroupées en 5 500 grappes suspendues au-dessus de la place des Festivals. De jour, les particules s’animeront par la transludité du givre. Que ce soit une couche de neige ou un film de glace, es ombres des particules qui se balancent animeront silencieusement la place. Dès la nuit tombée, des aurores boréales apparaîtront au passage des visiteurs. Les lueurs du Nuage de givre passeront progressivement du bleu au rouge au fil de l’hiver, marquant la nouvelle année aux couleurs du Quartier des spectacles. Une

The so-called Old Harbour of Reykjavik is the first lasting harbour of the town. It was constructed between 1913 and 1917 on the cove Reykjavik, after which the farm of the first settler and later the town were named. The Danish monopoly trading was moved from the spit of land called Orfirisey in 1780 to Reykjavik. During the 19th century the merchants constructed their own short and small piers as extensions from the warehouses into the cove. v.description: Reizend Zand in Apeldoorn
Reizend Zand in Apeldoorn

The art work 'reizend zand'(travelling sands), made in 2008 by artist Giny Vos . Near Apeldoorn Central Station (NL). Size: 100x4 meter; made of 1.3 million orange-yellow computer controlled LEDs. It shows ever moving sand dunes. Sometimes you can see them moving very fast, other times the movements are very subtle.

v.description: The Rock School for Dance Education was founded in 1963 as the School of the Pennsylvania Ballet, and became independent in 1992. The school has two facilities, "Rock West" in West Chester, Pennsylvania, and "Rock Center", seen here, at 1101 South Broad Street at Washington Street in the Point Breeze neighborhood of South Philadelphia in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The building is a former car dealership that was bought and renovated by the Pennsylvania Ballet, but sold to the Rock School when the Ballet was unable to meet the mortgage. The Ballet and the school shared the building until 2007.

v.description: Kirchstraße, Wuppertal

Wuppertal, Alte reformierte Kirche Elberfeld, auf der 22 x 10 Meter messenden Fassadenplane an der Kirchstraße, die aufgrund von Restaurierungsarbeiten auf der Nordseite der Kirche nötig wurde, wurde nach einer aquarellierten Vorlage der Künstlerin Inga Beitz-Svechtarov ein Dschungel-Wimmelbild aufgebracht, das die Passanten im Zentrum der Elberfelder Fußgängerzone erfreuen soll. Am linken Bildrand ist eine unter Denkmalschutz stehende Leuchtreklame zu sehen, die einst für die frühere Maxim-Bar warb.
